evidence.title: Market
evidence.summary: This source directly states that the IGC Grains and Oilseeds Index (GOI) for wheat declined by 2.6% month-over-month in January 2023, which is a key mechanism for the negative return. It also mentions competitive supplies from Russia and Ukraine as a factor.

evidence.summary: This source provides specific price changes for US wheat in January 2023, indicating a decline for hard wheat and a slight increase for soft red winter wheat futures, contributing to the overall negative global trend.

evidence.title: Precios futuros internacionales de trigo y maíz. enero 2023
evidence.summary: This source provides daily future prices for wheat (Soft Red Winter and Hard Red Winter) traded on the Chicago and Kansas exchanges in January 2023, which are key indicators for global wheat prices.

evidence.title: 26 de enero de 2023
evidence.summary: This source provides daily grain market data from Chicago, Kansas, and Winnipeg for January 26, 2023, offering specific price points that contribute to the overall monthly average and trend.

evidence.title: Inflation of wheat-based product prices outpaced overall food price inflation in 2022 | Economic Research Service
evidence.summary: While focused on 2022, this source provides context on the elevated commodity prices for wheat leading into 2023, which could influence market sentiment and price movements in January.

evidence.title: South American weather moves market - Farm and Dairy
evidence.summary: This article highlights the impact of South American weather on the market, which can affect global supply expectations and thus wheat prices, providing a contextual factor for price fluctuations in January.

evidence.title: Purchase prices for grains in Ukraine on January 23, 2023
evidence.summary: This source provides specific purchase prices for grains in Ukraine in January 2023. Ukraine is a major wheat exporter, and its prices directly influence global supply and pricing dynamics, contributing to the overall market trend.

evidence.title: Biweekly Price and Policy Update_Week of January 15- 2023_Dhaka_Bangladesh_BG2023-0002.pdf
evidence.summary: This report provides a biweekly price update, including for flour, which is directly derived from wheat. It offers specific price data points within January 2023 that contribute to understanding the monthly trend.
